claims.statement: For every limit, session, request and store, execute returns a Legal result: every Accepted result has a Step witness for the allowed indexed state transition.
Guest create and edit requests always return Denied Unauthorized, for every store and body.
For every accepted execute of EditPost by Logged u: the original target is OwnedAt u and before/after stores satisfy AllProtected u pointwise.
Protected cells not owned by the actor are identical; all protected cells retain their original owner.
For every input glyph list, every output glyph of render is Plain SafeChar or Amp. Raw Lt, Gt, DQuote and SQuote cannot occur.
Fits n text implies Fits (sixTimes n) (render text): at most 6 output glyphs per input glyph.
Every accepted create/edit by execute has a body fitting the supplied text limit.
If the starting store Fits the supplied post limit, every accepted execute result Fits that same limit.

assumptions: Correct auth adapter binding bearer tokens to server-side User values
Correct ASCII glyph/byte conversion and HTML text-node placement; no reparse into script/style/attribute/URL context
Correct GHC/agda2hs, runtime, OS, dependencies and scripts
unverified: HTTP/JSON parsing, nesting and wire-byte limits
Credentials, entropy, session tokens, session capacity and atomic state integration
Browser HTML parsing, CSP and response headers
Overall CPU/heap/network limits, denial of service and concurrency semantics
Authentication strength, TLS, persistence and production deployment

compilerCertification.reason: The host-code compilers do not produce semantic-preservation evidence in this experiment.

hashMeaning: SHA256 binds source, generated code, logs and executable bytes. It is not proof of translation correctness or authenticity.
